Critics considered the album innovative for its explosive, propulsive, and often staccato riff style which greatly exploited drop D tuning. The moody, atmospheric "Sinatra" differed from most of the fast-paced, metal-influenced songs on the album; its lyrics featured a paraphrasing of Dean Martin's famous line about the crooner, "It's Sinatra's world/ We just live in it."
